Name: Native Stratagem Radial r22 - Viewport Centering
Description: Revision 22: fixes vertical centering for all radial layouts by projecting the native GUI X/Z matrix. Both axes now use the viewport midpoint and inverse list transform. Vertical offset defaults to zero; saved preferences are preserved. Retains three selection modes, Cards/Expanded wedges layouts, full-color icons, native cursor tracking and Confirm. Requires Mod Options Menu, Mod Bindings Menu v2 and Bingus Shared Loader API 1.
